name: grndbrekers-bull-riding-studay2025
description: 🐂 Multi-device Bull Riding Leaderboard voor StuDAY 2025 - Realtime sync via WiFi hotspot

scripts.prestart:
node -e "console.log('
🛡️  BELANGRIJK: Controleer eerst firewall setup!
'); console.log('Als je problemen hebt met GSM verbinding:
'); console.log('1. Open PowerShell als Administrator
2. Run: .\firewall-setup.ps1
3. Dan: npm start
'); console.log('Of run: npm run setup-complete voor volledige setup
');"
scripts.setup-complete:
npm run doctor && echo "
🔥 Als doctor score < 90%, fix eerst issues hierboven!" && echo "
⚠️  Windows gebruikers: Run .\firewall-setup.ps1 als Administrator" && echo "
✅ Dan run: npm start"
scripts.test-server: node -e "const http = require('http'); http.get('http://localhost:3000/health', (res) => { let data = ''; res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk); res.on('end', () => { console.log('✅ Server health:', JSON.parse(data)); }); }).on('error', err => console.log('❌ Server not running:', err.message));"
scripts.test-clients: node -e "const http = require('http'); http.get('http://localhost:3000/clients', (res) => { let data = ''; res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk); res.on('end', () => { const clients = JSON.parse(data); console.log('👥 Connected clients:', clients.count); clients.clients.forEach(c => console.log('  📱', c.device, 'on', c.screen, '(' + c.ip + ')')); }); }).on('error', err => console.log('❌ Cannot get clients:', err.message));"
scripts.ip-info: node -e "const os = require('os'); const interfaces = os.networkInterfaces(); console.log('🌐 Available network interfaces:'); Object.keys(interfaces).forEach(name => { interfaces[name].forEach(iface => { if (iface.family === 'IPv4' && !iface.internal) { const isHotspot = iface.address.startsWith('192.168.137.') || iface.address.startsWith('192.168.43.'); console.log(isHotspot ? '🔥' : '📍', name + ':', iface.address); } }); });"
scripts.setup-firewall: echo "🛡️  Run dit commando als Administrator:" && echo ".\\firewall-setup.ps1"
scripts.remove-firewall: echo "🛡️  Run dit commando als Administrator:" && echo ".\\firewall-setup.ps1 -Remove"
scripts.validate: npm run doctor && npm run test-server
scripts.studay-ready: npm run doctor && echo "\n🎯 Checklist voor StuDAY 2025:" && echo "✅ Doctor score moet 90%+ zijn" && echo "✅ Firewall geconfigureerd (.\\firewall-setup.ps1)" && echo "✅ Hotspot actief (GRNDbrekers-Bull)" && echo "✅ Server start zonder errors" && echo "\n🚀 Als alles ✅ is: npm start"
scripts.quick-setup:
echo "
🚀 GRNDbrekers Bull Riding - Quick Setup
" && echo "1️⃣  npm install (done)" && echo "2️⃣  npm run doctor" && echo "3️⃣  .\firewall-setup.ps1 (als Administrator)" && echo "4️⃣  npm start
" && echo "📱 Voor StuDAY: npm run studay-ready"

author: Serge Hanssens
